title: WCL Mining Sirdar Mock Test 05
subtitle: Western Coalfields Limited — Mining Sirdar Recruitment
instructions: Select the best answer for each question

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'settling of stowing material' in goaf occurs because
options: Water drains away and material settles under gravity
questions.solution: Material settles as water drains and gravity acts.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The minimum percentage of incombustible content required in roadways to prevent coal dust explosion propagation is
questions.solution: Minimum 65% incombustible content is required.

Neither the first nor the second option

questions.solution: The upper explosive limit is approximately 2000 g/m³.

questions.stem: The 'ventilation resistance' in mine airways is affected by

questions.solution: Board and pillar involves driving galleries and leaving pillars for roof support.
